events.title: Brand-New Demo Launches Today for Steam Next Fest, Gameplay Fully Revamped
events.summary: Three months after the release of our first public demo, we are launching this revamped demo for Steam Next Fest. This version delivers an experience much closer to the full release. On one hand, we added key gameplay systems as scheduled in our development roadmap. events.title: A brand-new Demo is coming soon for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: No Mortal Space is confirmed to participate in Steam Next Fest starting October 19th, where a brand-new Demo will be released. This new version adds plenty of gameplay content with major changes to the game progression, so it will not be compatible with save files from the current Demo. To prevent inconvenience for players during the transition between old and new versions, we will disable downloads for the old Demo starting October 2nd. events.title: The demo of No Mortal Space is out now!
events.summary: The demo version of No Mortal Space is now available. This released demo supports online multiplayer. Due to tight scheduling, the game’s English texts are currently AI-translated and have not yet undergone LQA. If this is a concern for you, we recommend waiting a few more days. We will release an updated version with polished English translations as soon as possible.You can expect around 5-10 hours of main quest gameplay in this demo, Build massive starships and venture into space to explore. events.title: The demo of No Mortal Space will be released on July 8th
events.summary: During the INDIE LIVE Expo in April, we announced that the public demo of No Mortal Space would be released on July 8th. The first closed beta test is currently underway, and we will begin recruitment for the second closed beta in mid-May.The current closed beta version offers roughly 5 hours of gameplay.
